items.name: tokens
items.title: templapp Tokens
items.description: The design tokens every component reads: shadcn's token set at React Native Reusables' neutral values, plus a `--warning` semantic for degraded (not failed) states.
items.author: Alejo Garcia
items.docs:
Adds the token set to your global.css. Pair it with the Tailwind colour mappings in templapp’s tailwind.config.js — tokens alone do nothing until `bg-primary` resolves to `hsl(var(--primary))`.

Check the dark block after installing: the shadcn CLI writes the dark tokens under `.dark`, but NativeWind toggles the scheme on the root element and needs `.dark:root`. Left as `.dark`, dark mode silently does nothing.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: The resolved palette and colour-scheme hooks, for the places that take a colour value instead of a class name — React Navigation, status bar, native props.
items.author: Alejo Garcia
items.docs:
`colors.ts` is a second copy of the tokens in hex, because React Navigation and native props take resolved colours rather than class names. templapp keeps the two honest with `src/theme/colors.test.ts`, which parses global.css and converts each token — copy that test too, or the palette will drift the first time you re-theme.

This item deliberately omits `theme-provider.tsx`: it reads the persisted colour-scheme preference from templapp's `@/data` store, so it only makes sense inside templapp.

Run `npx expo install --fix` — the CLI writes caret ranges, which resolve ahead of your Expo SDK matrix.
